name: NavList
need: A reusable vertical navigation list (NavList + NavItem) decoupled from router/auth/i18n. The only navigation in the repo is shell/Sidebar, which is hard-wired to react-router NavLink, AuthProvider roles, SidebarProvider and i18n, so it cannot be reused by another app (the AI/Run cockpit had to hand-roll its nav). NavItem should support active state, a leading icon, a label + optional sub-label, and an optional trailing slot (e.g. a Badge). shell/Sidebar can later be refactored to compose it.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: App-coupled (router, auth roles, sidebar context, i18n); not a reusable primitive.
ListItem is a content row (avatar/meta/actions), not a nav item with active state + route semantics + trailing slot.
No active state, no sub-label, no trailing slot, no group semantics/aria.

NavItem.label: string (or children)
NavItem.onClick: () => void  // consumer wires routing; component is routing-agnostic

note: Navigation DOES exist as shell/AppShell + shell/Sidebar. Not a missing component. The only real question is whether to decouple Sidebar into a routing-agnostic primitive so a non-app project can reuse it; deferred. For the cockpit, reuse AppShell/Sidebar directly (build inside the app) rather than add a new primitive.
